# Blameless framing

`customer_support.df.root_cause_analysis.blameless_framing` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Blameless framing — treat every human action in the timeline as the reasonable output of the information and incentives available at that moment, and ask what made it reasonable.

Not a courtesy. It is the mechanism that keeps the people who saw what happened willing to say so, and every organisation that abandons it loses its evidence supply within a couple of incidents.
